title: UAP mint request (uap-mint/1)
description: The administrative envelope that asks the kernel to sign one grant, lease or approval. Separate from `uap-authorize/1` on purpose: an authorization call can never mint the authority it is about to honour. The seed is supplied on stdin by the CLI, never as an argument.

seed_hex.description: 32-byte Ed25519 seed, hex. Test vectors only; a live issuer reads it from the operator's key material.
